pillars.name: Concepts
pillars.desc: What gets built on Ethereum and why it holds up. Incentive design, the walkaway test, decentralization, MEV, EIP-1559, EIP-712, the fork roadmap.

pillars.name: Transactions
pillars.desc: Reading the chain. Calldata, selectors, ABIs, events, receipts, gas, what a block explorer is really showing you.

pillars.name: Building
pillars.desc: Shipping a dApp real users can touch. Approvals, decimals, USD context, RPCs, indexing, keys, and the whole way to production.

pillars.name: Security
pillars.desc: Everyone catches reentrancy. Inflation attacks, stale oracles, signature replay, upgrade collisions, rounding, and the rest.
